evidence.value: exact SHA dcb2b5785dd43bdd68b76485fa699b130548940b on Linux kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure: pinned GHCR Manifest sha256:0a922f17a02b48d58b2c4595da9cef0aa0909891d9a232dc394e2738c88d580d (EROFS sha256:7ad4db01530282b6c49e692a221cd6b87ba428448894385f7d2713c3a899c609) prepared cold with 3 transfers, then reused after Agent restart with fetch_count=0 and a Verified observation

the authorized peer served the exact published layer with zero Server blob bytes; after revocation the fallback went only to the authorized Server for the identical pinned digest
